heroHeadline: Day 595: Judicial Elections Postponed to 2028 (Constitutional Reform Proposed); EU-Mexico Summit in 3 Days; Second Sinaloa DOJ Indictee Surrenders to U.S.
heroSubtitle: On May 18–19, 2026 (Days 594–595), three major developments defined the start of the week. JUDICIAL REFORM (PHASE 3): On May 18, Sheinbaum announced a constitutional reform to postpone the next round of federal Judicial Power elections from 2027 to June 4, 2028, citing overlap with 18-state gubernatorial elections and the need for improved candidate vetting. Morena's supermajority has the votes; La Jornada confirmed the reform is advancing to an extraordinary congressional session. Critics frame it as backtracking from the reform's own electoral mandate following the June 2025 elections' 13% turnout. SINALOA SOVEREIGNTY: On May 18, former Sinaloa Finance Secretary Enrique Díaz Vega surrendered to U.S. federal authorities in New York — the second of the 10 April 29 DOJ indictees (after General Mérida Salgado on May 16). Sheinbaum's mañanera response: 'No risk, none — it was their decision to surrender,' while reiterating Mexico's counter: 'The U.S. has rejected 36 of our extradition requests for insufficient evidence.' In the same mañanera, Sheinbaum blocked a proposed cruise development at the Mahahual reef in Quintana Roo and confirmed Spain's King Felipe VI will attend the Uruguay vs. Spain World Cup match in Guadalajara. EU-MEXICO SUMMIT (MAY 22): The 8th EU-Mexico Summit — first in 11 years — is three days away: EU Council President António Costa and Commission President Ursula von der Leyen will sign the Modernised EU-Mexico Global Agreement and Interim Trade Agreement (approved by all 27 EU states May 11), projected to boost bilateral commerce by ~35%. The summit directly strengthens Mexico's USMCA negotiating hand ahead of the first formal bilateral round (week of May 25, U.S. envoys in Mexico City ~May 27). Health Secretary Kershenobich announced May 19 that Mexico is 'prepared and vigilant' for hantavirus/Ebola scenarios ahead of the FIFA World Cup.
